doc.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 17, 2022 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Sun Ra as leader and spiritual advisor to the Chicago group
summary: The Chicago group revered Sun Ra as leader and spiritual advisor, while Harrison, a bebop thinker, had to be weaned off chord changes.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: I don’t mean to sound disrespectful at all but did you ever get the notion in your head like man this cat’s kind of crazy?

Of course. Everybody did. But his family, I call them the family, the group that came from Chicago, I mean they were really serious about Sun Ra and they really respected him as a leader and as a spiritual advisor. I wasn’t there yet. Because like I was telling you I’m a bebop — I have a bebop mentality and everything in my world had changes. Everything in my world had changes and that was my master, the keyboard and the — I worshipped chord changes at that particular time.
